title: DDU Gorakhpur 2015 to 2021 Result Verification
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ddugu.ac.in or university result portal
2. Open Result Verification / Student services
3. Enter roll number, course and year (2015–2021)
4. View result / request verification certificate
5. Download or apply for official verification letter as needed
shortDescription: DDU Gorakhpur University Result Verification 2015 to 2021 – verify marksheets online via official university portal.
content:
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University provides online result viewing and verification facilities for past sessions.

Students and employers can verify results for years 2015 to 2021 (and other available sessions) through the official university website. For sealed verification packages, follow the university examination section process.
